title: Confession and Portrait
author: Lena Hartwell
blurb: Ansel Lockridge, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
